q.en: Does the kit need a laptop or computer?
q.hi: Kya kit ko laptop ya computer chahiye?

a.en: Some advanced kits (like Coding or Arduino) may need a laptop, but our basic and electronics kits work without one.
a.hi: Kuch advanced kits (jaise Coding ya Arduino) ko laptop chahiye hota hai, par basic aur electronics kits bina laptop ke chalti hain.

q.en: How much time does it take to build a project?
q.hi: Ek project banane me kitna time lagta hai?

a.en: Each project takes around 30 minutes to 2 hours depending on the child’s age and the kit type.
a.hi: Har project lagbhag 30 minutes se 2 hours leta hai, bacche ki age aur kit type par depend karta hai.

a.en: Yes. All components are reusable so kids can build multiple projects from one kit.
a.hi: Haan, saare components reusable hain, ek kit se kai projects ban sakte hain.

q.en: Do I need any extra tools or materials?
q.hi: Kya extra tools ya materials chahiye honge?

a.en: No extra tools required. Everything needed is included in the box.
a.hi: Nahi, koi extra tools nahi chahiye. Saari cheezein box me hi milti hain.

q.hi: Kya ye bacchon ke liye safe hai?

a.en: Yes, our kits are made from child-safe and quality tested materials.
a.hi: Haan, ye kits child-safe aur quality tested materials se bani hoti hain.

q.hi: Kya parents madad kar sakte hain?

a.en: Yes, these kits are great for parent-child learning and bonding.
a.hi: Haan, ye kits parent-child learning aur bonding ke liye bahut achhi hain.

q.en: Does my child need prior robotics knowledge?
q.hi: Kya bacche ko robotics ki knowledge pehle se chahiye?

a.en: No. Our kits start from basics with simple step-by-step instructions.
a.hi: Nahi. Ye kits basics se shuru hoti hain aur step-by-step instructions deti hain.

q.hi: Delivery me kitna time lagta hai?

a.en: Delivery usually takes 3–7 working days across India.
a.hi: Delivery India me aam taur par 3–7 working days leti hai.

q.en: What if a part is missing or damaged?
q.hi: Agar koi part missing ya damaged ho to?

a.en: Contact our support team and we’ll replace the missing or damaged part quickly.
a.hi: Support team se contact karein, hum missing/damaged part jaldi replace kar denge.

q.en: Do you offer returns or refunds?
q.hi: Kya aap return ya refund dete ho?

a.en: Yes, we offer a 7-day return policy for unused kits in original packaging.
a.hi: Haan, unused kits ke liye 7-day return policy available hai.

q.en: Do you organize workshops for schools?
q.hi: Kya aap schools ke liye workshops karte ho?

a.en: Yes, we conduct robotics and STEM workshops for schools and learning centers.
a.hi: Haan, hum schools aur learning centers ke liye robotics & STEM workshops karte hain.

q.en: Can we get a demo before purchase?
q.hi: Kya purchase se pehle demo mil sakta hai?

a.en: Yes, schools can request a free online demo session.
a.hi: Haan, schools free online demo session request kar sakte hain.

q.en: What if my kit stops working?
q.hi: Agar meri kit kaam karna band kar de to?

a.en: You can message our team and we will troubleshoot or replace the component.
a.hi: Aap hume message kar sakte hain, hum troubleshoot ya component replace kar denge.

a.en: Yes, students receive a Tinkro Robotics Certificate after completing kits or workshops.
a.hi: Haan, students ko kits/workshop complete karne par Tinkro Robotics Certificate milta hai.

q.hi: Kya Tinkro international shipping karta hai?

a.en: Currently we deliver only across India. International shipping coming soon.
a.hi: Abhi hum sirf India me deliver karte hain. International shipping jaldi aa rahi hai.

q.en: Do you offer a discount on bulk orders?
q.hi: Kya bulk order par discount milta hai?

a.en: Yes! Schools and bulk orders get special discounted prices and priority delivery.
a.hi: Haan! Schools aur bulk orders par special discount aur priority delivery milti hai.
